test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 22 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A camp has provisions for 20 pupils for 12 days. In how many days will the same provisions be used up, if the strength of the camp is increased to 80 pupils?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The total quantity of provisions remains constant, so we use the inverse proportion rule: M₁ × D₁ = M₂ × D₂

⇒ 20 × 12 = 80 × D₂

⇒ 240 = 80 × D₂

⇒ D₂ = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial number of pupils (M₁) = 20

Initial number of days (D₁) = 12

Final number of pupils (M₂) = 80

**Formula Used:**

M₁ × D₁ = M₂ × D₂

 
 Provisions
 20 Pupils × 12 Days

 80 Pupils × ? Days
 

 Same Total Quantity

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total provisions available = 20 × 12 = 240 pupil-days

⇒ Let the new provisions last for D₂ days for 80 pupils

⇒ 80 × D₂ = 240

⇒ D₂ = 240 ÷ 80

⇒ D₂ = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Proportion

When one quantity increases while the other decreases such that their product remains constant. Formula: x₁ × y₁ = x₂ × y₂.

Direct Proportion

When two quantities increase or decrease together in the same ratio. Formula: x₁ ÷ y₁ = x₂ ÷ y₂.

MDH Rule (Chain Rule)

Used to solve complex variations in time and work questions directly: (M₁ × D₁ × H₁) ÷ W₁ = (M₂ × D₂ × H₂) ÷ W₂.
